detail.longDescription: 🎉 Today marks 31 years since the first public announcement of GIMP! On 21 November 1995, Peter Mattis introduced the GNU Image Manipulation Program to the world. Since then, GIMP has become an important part of the free and open-source software ecosystem Thank you to community members who keep the project alive and growing. 💙 Happy 31st anniversary, GIMP! Explore GIMP on OpenSourceFeed: https://www. opensourcefeed.org/software/gi mp/ Official website: https://www. gimp.org/ # GIMP # OpenSource # FreeSoftware # FOSS
